summary: GL-PORT-001 Portal Pages Testing Complete. Both /intake and /onboarding standalone portal pages are fully functional. Fixed a critical bug in RadioGroup component (missing onClick handler). All 14 backend API tests pass. All frontend features verified.
passed_tests: === INTAKE PAGE (/intake) ===
✓ Page loads with dark brand system (#1A1A1A background, #E8B84B gold accents)
✓ Sidebar nav shows 7 sections (Company, Operations, Safety, Documents, Needs, Budget, Consent)
✓ Section 1 (Company) has all required fields: company name, address, contact, email, phone, employees, schedule
✓ Conditional schedule fields appear when selecting 2-shifts (Employees per shift, Same operations, Shifts to include)
✓ Conditional schedule fields appear when selecting 12hr-rotating (Employees per rotation, Rotation pattern)
✓ Sidebar section navigation works (click Continue, sidebar updates)
✓ Section 2 (Operations) has industry dropdown, operations checkboxes
✓ Section 3 (Safety) has required programs matrix with color-coded radio dots (Yes/No/N/A/Not Sure)
✓ Section 4 (Documents) has existing docs matrix and file upload zone
✓ Section 5 (Needs) has help needed checkboxes and urgency radio
✓ Section 6 (Budget) has budget options and preferred days
✓ Section 7 (Consent) has acknowledgment checkbox, submit button
✓ No global Navbar/Footer visible (standalone portal)
=== ONBOARDING PAGE (/onboarding) ===
✓ Page loads with dark brand system and step indicators (1-5)
✓ Step 1 (Overview) shows stat tiles (On-site, Written, 24-48 hrs) and info cards (Included, Not Included, Retainer Option)
✓ Step 2 (Facility) has company, contact, email, phone, employees fields
✓ Step 3 (Service Tier) shows 3 tier cards (Small $650, Medium $750, Large $900)
✓ Step 4 (Retainer) shows Walkthrough Only vs Compliance Retainer cards with 'Recommended' badge
✓ Step 5 (Payment) shows order summary with tier price and preferred date field
✓ No global Navbar/Footer visible (standalone portal)
=== HOMEPAGE REGRESSION ===
✓ Homepage still works with global Navbar and Footer
=== BACKEND API TESTS (14/14 passed) ===
✓ GET /api/health returns {status: ok}
✓ GET /api/onboarding/tiers returns 3 tiers (small, medium, large)
✓ Small tier: $650, 1-75 employees
✓ Medium tier: $750, 75-250 employees
✓ Large tier: $900, 250+ employees
✓ POST /api/intake/submit stores submission in MongoDB (returns submissionId)
✓ POST /api/intake/submit rejects without consent (400)
✓ POST /api/intake/submit handles full data payload
✓ POST /api/onboarding/checkout creates valid Stripe checkout URL (https://checkout.stripe.com/...)
✓ POST /api/onboarding/checkout works for all tiers (small, medium, large)
✓ POST /api/onboarding/checkout works with retainer option
✓ POST /api/onboarding/checkout rejects invalid tier (400)

bugs_fixed.issue: RadioGroup component missing onClick handler - radio buttons were not responding to clicks
bugs_fixed.fix: Added onClick={() => onChange(opt.value)} to the label element in RadioGroup component

seed_data_creation: Test submissions created with TEST_ prefix in MongoDB collections gl_intake_submissions and gl_bookings
context_for_next_testing_agent: GL-PORT-001 portal pages fully implemented and tested. /intake is a 7-section client safety intake form with sidebar nav, conditional fields for schedule types, file uploads, and consent checkbox. /onboarding is a 5-step walkthrough booking portal with tier selection ($650/$750/$900), retainer option, and Stripe checkout integration. Both pages are STANDALONE (no global Navbar/Footer) with dark brand system (#1A1A1A backgrounds, #E8B84B gold accents). All data-testid attributes in place for testing. RadioGroup bug was fixed (missing onClick handler).
